The '''Ninth Hall of Justice''' was located in the [[Galactic Justice Center]] on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], the [[Trial of Tahiri Veila|trial]] of former [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] and [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Tahiri Veila]] was held in the Ninth Hall of Justice.
